title: Mozambique - Implementation of the Tax Collection Support System Software
detail_text: Project Name Promotion of Reforms and Investment in Agriculture (PRIA) Procurement Title Implementation of the Tax Collection Support System Software Procurement Ref. Number MOZ-26-3016 Type of Procurement Procurement of Information Systems (Firms) Selection Method Competitive Bidding (CB) Accountable Entity Millennium Challenge Account – Moçambique Publication Date April 14, 2026 Submission Deadline May 26, 2026 1. The Millennium Challenge Account-Mozambique has received financing from the Millennium Challenge Corporation toward the implementation of the Promotion of Reforms and Investment in Agriculture Project (PRIA) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Implementation of the Tax Collection Support System Software. 2. MCC’s funding is appropriated by the U.S. Congress and obligated to the compact up-front, with no incremental or partial funding. So when a contract is signed with an Accountable Entity, money is already available to the Accountable Entity and, for most contracts, invoices are paid directly to Offerors by the US-Treasury. The Compact and its related documents can be found on the MCC website (www.mcc.gov). 3. The Request For Offers (RFO) is open to all eligible entities (“Offerors”) as defined in the MCC Procurement and Policy Guidelines (PPG). The procurement will be conducted through the Competitive Bidding (“CB”) procedure in accoordance with the PPG and is open to all eligible Offerors. 4. Offerors interested in submitting an Offer should be registered by using the following link: https://forms.office.com/r/Hh8929xGrW 5. A Pre-Offer Conference will be held at 3:00 pm Mozambique time on April 23, 2026 via an online event specified in the DS ITO 1.3. 6. Offers must be delivered electronically to https://u.pcloud.com/#/puplink?code=GS1XZHaNfmgye0apFvq3MzqDuIhHwFO9k on or before 3:00 pm Mozambique time, on May 26, 2026. Late offers will be rejected. 7. Clarifications may be requested by e-mail to the Procurement Agent up to twenty-one (21) days before the date of submission of bids, at the address indicated below. Contact Information: Attn: Procurement Agent MCA-Moçambique Avenida da Marginal, Nº 9149A, RC Maputo, Mozambique Tel: +258 84 839 5584 E-mail: mcamocambiquepa@dt-global.com DISCLAIMER: THIS NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. FOR UPDATES ON THIS SOLICITATION PLEASE FOLLOW THE FULL ANNOUNCEMENT AT THE LINK PROVIDED. THIS PROCUREMENT IS NOT CONDUCTED UNDER THE FEDERAL ACQUISITION REGULATIONS, IS NOT ADMINISTERED BY THE US GOVERNMENT, AND THE RESULTING AWARD WILL BE MADE BY THE COUNTRY INDICATED IN THE FULL ANNOUNCEMENT. FOR MORE INFORMATION ON THIS PROCUREMENT PLEASE CONTRACT THE PERSON NAMED IN THE FULL ANNOUNCEMENT.
